Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring development of recommendations for kindergarten entry assessments.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to kindergarten entry assessment; and creating anew section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Within existing resources, thedepartment of early learning, in collaboration with the office of thesuperintendent of public instruction, shall recommend six kindergartenentry assessments for statewide implementation. The assessments shallbe chosen based on the recommendations established in the reportrequired by the legislature under section 616(14), chapter 329, Laws of2008. (2) For each recommended assessment, the department shall: (a) Provide a detailed description of the assessment; (b) Identify the purpose of the assessment; and (c) Identify the costs of the assessment, including the timerequired to administer the assessment. (3) The department shall submit a report with recommendations forsix kindergarten entry assessments to the governor and appropriate p. 1 SB 5619committees of the legislature by December 1, 2009.
